title: Concatenation law for tabulation gates
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite set of instruction kinds, let $m,w,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $F$ assign to each kind a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For any two finite instruction lists $p,q$ and any starting position $i$, the gates tabulated for their concatenation, starting at $i$, are the concatenation of the gates for $p$ starting at $i$ and the gates for $q$ starting at $i+|p|$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ maps each instruction kind and Boolean list to a Boolean list
$p,q$ are finite lists of instructions with kinds in $\kappa$
